name: KRUART Engineering Eval
policy: Execution-first; confirmed incidents become durable regressions against canonical project authority.

scenarios.evidence: Production release source SHA equals the approved exact revision.
Vault active revision is synced to canonical source with zero source drift.
Control bundle dependency closure includes every required runtime dependency.
Exactly one mutating execution owns the project and releases authority after completion.
Verified pre-mutation backup and exact rollback identity are recorded.
SQLite integrity is ok and foreign-key violations are zero.
Login GET remains method-blocked and unauthenticated control session remains unauthorized.
Public shell returns HTTP 200 and reports exact release identity.
Post-deploy source-drift verification passes.
Desktop package verification is VERIFIED and lineage is explicit.
Operator bridge exposes typed allowlisted actions and never arbitrary shell.
Mixed repeated PASS and FAIL is UNSTABLE and blocks autonomous promotion.
Student, class and enrollment counts remain consistent without orphan, duplicate or invalid rows.
Saved records survive reload and read-back without becoming zero.
Room changes persist and appear consistently in teacher and class views.
All Parent Connect entry points resolve to the current LIFF endpoints.
Linking an existing parent or device never creates duplicate identity rows.
Official A4 geometry and signatory placement remain inside approved template bounds.
A previously enrolled student machine recovers the same identity after browser state loss.
An enrolled student can start a real mission from the student surface.
Student-visible game and lesson surfaces use canonical names instead of placeholders.
An active lesson resumes after transient network loss without duplicate progress.
Teacher and student device roles remain consistent with BAY identity authority.
Verification incidents and release capsules persist in the bounded AWH evidence registry, and matching changed paths recall deterministic regression IDs.
The school name is exactly โรงเรียนบ้านเอือดใหญ่ everywhere it represents the school.
Critical mobile viewports have no horizontal overflow or clipped controls.
Real school claims use verified first-party school media rather than fabricated documentary imagery.
